title: 第2章 找来古人干活
novel_title: 我在星际召唤古人，带飞华夏文明
content_zh:
花期没有第一时间回答荣华，而是先问了小助手两个世界时间流速问题。

    “我们这边时间和誉朝时间流速如何？”

    【城主，上班期间古城时间一天，誉朝那边十分钟，下班和休息时间流速则相同，这个时间包括所有世界】

    花期了然，对荣华微微颔首，“当然了，我这边包吃不包住，最少也要干一个月，每干五天活休息两天，一个月可以休息八天。”

    “只要你和我签了合同，我就能给你治病的仙丹，每天下班也能回去。”

    以前在蓝星实习时被单休折磨怕了，好不容易翻身农奴把歌唱，她说什么也要给员工撑一把伞。

    双休，全世界都给她双休！

    当然她更想三休。

    荣华一喜，刚要一口应下，但转头想起自己原本的世界，又一脸为难地欠了欠身。

    “仙子，妾身能得您的眷顾，乃是妾身的荣幸。但妾身是流放的犯人，现在还在流放路上，长久离开肯定不行，所以仙子的美意妾身无法应允。”

    她知道说出这个话一定会得罪仙子，有可能还会被挂上大不敬的名头。

    但是全家人都还在驿站等她，她如果不回去，会被钦差判定逃逸，最后连累得还是家里人。

    花期轻笑一声：“放心，这里乃是本城主的地方，你来是什么样，出去了还是什么样，时间最多只会过去一刻钟。”

    她将小助拟好的合同推送到荣华面前：“你决定了就在上面写下你的名字。”

    荣华听完瞳孔一缩，怔怔地看着飞到自己面前的‘仙器’。

    仙器四周透明，只有中间挂着羊皮卷，上面用文字写着工作内容。

    奇怪的是，文字不是她熟悉的文字，可是内容却能看懂。

    荣华迅速看完古城的一条条规矩，也明白了大致的工作时间，二话不说在角落处一笔一画写下自己的大名。

    帮着城主建设打理古城，每天还能吃三顿饭，今天要能得到膳食，省一省可以带回去给家里人吃。

    最后一笔落定，羊皮卷自动消失。

    荣华垂了下头，“仙子，妾身一定不辱使命。”

    “叫我城主。”

    花期让荣华改了称呼，在个人终端上看了眼合同没什么问题，便背手走上街道。

    “跟上。”

    荣华紧随其后，落后花期半步，迈着小碎步跟上。

    花期余光瞄了一眼她的动作，体态良好，行走间衣摆不动，果然是大户人家。
content_en:
Huaqi did not answer Ronghua immediately, but first asked the assistant two questions about the flow rate of world time.

    "How fast does time flow between us and Yuchao?"

    [City Lord, one day in the ancient city during work, ten minutes in Yuchao, the flow rate is the same during get off work and rest time, this time includes all worlds]

    The flower period was clear, and he nodded slightly to Rong Hua, "Of course, I will provide food and accommodation here, and I will have to work for at least a month. I have two days off for every five days of work, and I can rest for eight days a month."

    "As long as you sign a contract with me, I can give you the elixir to cure your illness, and you can go back to get off work every day."

    When she was an intern at Blue Star, she was afraid of being tortured by being alone. She finally turned around and started singing. She insisted on holding an umbrella for the employees no matter what.

    Double holidays, the whole world gives her double holidays!

    Of course she would rather take a three-day break.

    Rong Hua was overjoyed and was about to agree, but then he turned around and remembered his original world, and bowed again with an embarrassed look on his face.

    "Fairy, it is my honor to receive your favor. But I am an exiled prisoner and am still on the road to exile. I will definitely not be able to leave you for a long time, so I cannot agree to the fairy's kindness."

    She knew that saying this would definitely offend the fairy, and she might even be labeled disrespectful.

    But the whole family is still waiting for her at the inn. If she doesn't go back, she will be judged by the imperial envoy as having escaped, and in the end the family will be affected.

    Huaqi chuckled softly: "Don't worry, this is the place of my city lord. It will be the same when you come in, and it will be the same when you leave. At most, a quarter of an hour will pass."

    She pushed the contract prepared by Xiaozhu to Ronghua: "When you decide, just write your name on it."

    After hearing this, Ronghua's pupils shrank and he stared blankly at the 'immortal weapon' flying in front of him.

    The surroundings of the immortal tool are transparent, with only the parchment hanging in the middle, with the work content written on it.

    The strange thing is that the text is not familiar to her, but the content is understandable.

    Ronghua quickly read through the rules of the ancient city and understood the approximate working hours. Without saying a word, he wrote his name in the corner one by one.

    Helping the city lord build and maintain the ancient city, you can still eat three meals a day. If you can get meals today, you can save something and take it back to your family.

    The last stroke is settled, and the parchment disappears automatically.

    Ronghua lowered his head, "Fairy, I will definitely fulfill my mission."

    "Call me City Lord."

    Huaqi asked Ronghua to change his name, checked the contract on his personal terminal and found nothing wrong, then walked onto the street with his hands behind his back.

    "Follow up."

    Ronghua followed closely behind, half a step behind Huaqi, and kept up with small steps.

    Hua Qi glanced at her movements out of the corner of her eye. She was in good shape and her clothes didn't move when she walked. She was indeed from a wealthy family.
title_en: Chapter 2 Recruiting ancient people to work
